name: Move one towel from the left pile to the working area
Straighten the towel flat, cross hems at the top and bottom
Fold the towel lengthwise in half, long edge to long edge
Fold the strip widthwise in half, short edge to short edge
Pull the folded towel aside to clear space
Drag the pile next to the folded towel
Lift the folded towel onto the pile
Drag the folded towel or pile to the back-right pile location
Confirm the end state, return both arms home, and end the episode
